# REAL WORLD SCENARIOS

# Interviews:  
If i am ask to explain a caching system design but i always relied on AI; I will find it difficult or freeze in the process of providing answers.

# Production Bug: At 2 AM, you must debug code generated by AI months ago - but AI is offline. Can you fix it?
   I can't fix it if i don't understand the technicallities.
   
   # New Technology: A new library is released, and AI hasn't been trained on it yet. How do you learn it?
   - I can read official documentation
   - I will be intentional about what the new technology does
   - Operate the technoology based on manufacturer's instruction
   - Read and interpret the sampled diagram carefully

  
  # REFLECTION
    Using AI fairly as an assistant instead of a replacement trains me to verify outputs, deepening my understanding of concepts, and enables me to practice independent reasoning.Therefore, during interview, when production systems fail at night, or when new technology appears without guidance, I will still have the core skills of 
    Reading documentation, tracing logic, providing and proving answers and solving problems systematically. Moreso, responsible AI use today will build my confidence an competence ensuring I can operate confidently even when AI is unavailable.
